meta.title: Improve query update performance
meta.body_summary: Optimize Entity.destroy to iterate only active components, map queries by component for targeted updates, improve QueryManager.resetEntity efficiency, and add integration tests for new behavior.

core_change_summary.description: In Entity.destroy(), changed iteration to use only active component types instead of a broader loop. In QueryManager.ts, enhanced resetEntity to use a component-to-queries map for targeted updates, reducing unnecessary iteration. World.ts now passes the component manager to the query manager. Added integration tests for the new behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Integration test additions account for the majority of changed lines (120 of 193).
